$ systemctl --user --no-pager status hevd.service hev-serve.service | grep -E '●|Active:|ExecStart|Main PID'
● hevd.service - hev trace capture
     Active: active (running) since Tue 2026-11-17 21:11:57 UTC; 755ms ago
   Main PID: 181 (hev)
● hev-serve.service - hev dashboard (hev serve over the trace archive)
     Active: active (running) since Tue 2026-11-17 21:11:57 UTC; 559ms ago
   Main PID: 221 (hev)
[exit 0]
$ cat ~/.config/systemd/user/hev-serve.service
# Managed by hev up
[Unit]
Description=hev dashboard (hev serve over the trace archive)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart="/home/kit/.local/bin/hev" "serve" "--bind" "127.0.0.1" "--port" "8099"
Environment="HEV_CONFIG=/home/kit/.hev/config.toml"
Environment="PATH=/home/kit/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
[exit 0]
